// Generated from packages/capability-goal-decomposition/workflows/goal_intake_decompose/goal_intake_decompose.workflow-source.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
digraph goal_intake_decompose {
    label = "goal_intake_decompose"
    workflow_source = "packages/capability-goal-decomposition/workflows/goal_intake_decompose/goal_intake_decompose.workflow-source.mjs"
    typed_action_transport_mode = "enforced"
    workdir = "."
    analyze [class="goal_decomposer" benchmark_job_id="goal.decompose.analyze" llm_path_id="capability.goal_intake_decompose.analyze" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="goal.decompose" label="Analyze goal" output_key="goal_context" output_format="json" reasoning_effort="medium" timeout="${goal_decomposition_timeouts.issue_draft}" prompt="${goal_decomposer_system_prompt}\n\nRepository: ${gh_repo}\n\n${goal_decompose_analyze_task_prompt}\n\n--- Skill instructions ---\n${goal_analyzer_skill}\n--- End skill instructions ---\n\nIntent stack JSON:\n${intent_stack}\n\nGoal issue JSON:\n${goal_issue}\n\nExternal bug report JSON:\n${external_bug_report}\n\nExternal bug parse errors JSON:\n${external_bug_errors}\n\nExternal bug present:\n${external_bug_present}\n\nExternal bug intake activated:\n${external_bug_intake_activated}\n\nExisting issues JSON:\n${existing_issues}\n\nFeature inventory scan:\n${feature_inventory}" prompt_input_keys="gh_repo,goal_analyzer_skill,intent_stack,goal_issue,external_bug_report,external_bug_errors,external_bug_present,external_bug_intake_activated,existing_issues,feature_inventory" prompt_source="goal_decompose_analyze_task_prompt" session_id="goal-decomposer-${issue_number}" system_prompt_source="goal_decomposer_system_prompt" task_prompt_source="goal_decompose_analyze_task_prompt"]
    assess_decompose_auto_approve [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="ceremony.decompose_auto_approve" label="Assess decompose complexity floor" output_format="json" outputs="skip,auto_approve,approved,approved_features,factory_request_goal_graph,review_notes,reason,decompose_complexity,hatch_ceremony_pipeline,hatch_ceremony_skipped,hatch_ceremony_skip_reason,hatch_ceremony_reason" action_pipeline="goal_intake_decompose" action_decompose_auto_approve="${decompose_auto_approve}" action_features="${proposed_features}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    decide [shape="diamond" label="Approved?"]
    decompose_auto_gate [shape="diamond" label="Auto-approve decomposition?"]
    done [shape="Msquare" recovery_sink_type="terminal"]
    emit_retry_fallback_defect [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.emit_fallback_defect" label="Emit retry-exhausted fallback defect" output_key="retry_fallback_defect" action_goal_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="goal_intake_decompose" action_approved="${approved}" action_decompose_parse_status="${decompose_parse_status}" action_fallback_node="fallback" action_issues_created="0" action_trigger_reason="decompose_retry_exhausted" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    fallback [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.fallback_feature_pair" label="Fallback to latest reviewed features" output_key="approved_features" action_primary="${approved_features}" action_secondary="${proposed_features}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    fetch_issue [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Fetch goal issue" output_key="goal_issue" prompt="gh issue view ${issue_number} --repo ${gh_repo} --json number,title,body,labels,state" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    fetch_skill [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Fetch goal analyzer skill" output_key="goal_analyzer_skill" prompt="cat ${capability_goal_decomposition_skills}/goal_analyzer/current.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    goal_intake_gate [shape="diamond" label="Goal eligible for intake?"]
    inc_attempts [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.increment_counter" label="Increment attempts" output_key="decompose_attempts" action_value="${decompose_attempts}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    init_attempts [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Init review attempts" output_key="decompose_attempts" prompt="echo 0" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    init_parse_diagnostics [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Init parse diagnostics" output_format="json" outputs="decompose_parse_status,decompose_parse_error,decompose_proposed_excerpt,decompose_parse_source" prompt="printf '%s' '{\"decompose_parse_status\":\"not_inspected\",\"decompose_parse_error\":\"\",\"decompose_proposed_excerpt\":\"\",\"decompose_parse_source\":\"not_inspected\"}'" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    inject_retry_signal [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.build_retry_signal" label="Inject retry signal" output_key="review_notes" action_decompose_attempts="${decompose_attempts}" action_decompose_parse_error="${decompose_parse_error}" action_decompose_parse_status="${decompose_parse_status}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    inspect_approved [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.inspect_json_pair" label="Inspect approved features parse status" output_format="json" outputs="decompose_parse_status,decompose_parse_error,decompose_proposed_excerpt,decompose_parse_source" action_primary="${approved_features}" action_secondary="[]" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    inspect_fallback [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.inspect_json_pair" label="Inspect fallback parse status" output_format="json" outputs="decompose_parse_status,decompose_parse_error,decompose_proposed_excerpt,decompose_parse_source" action_primary="${approved_features}" action_secondary="${proposed_features}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    inspect_proposed_features [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.count_feature_objects" label="Inspect proposed feature count" output_key="__inspect_proposed_features_result" action_raw="${proposed_features}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    list_issues [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="List existing goal issues" output_key="existing_issues" prompt="gh issue list --repo ${gh_repo} --state open --label goal --limit 25 --json number,title,labels" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    load_goal_decompose_analyze_task_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load goal analyze task prompt" output_key="goal_decompose_analyze_task_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/goal_decomposer/analyze.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    load_goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load goal propose task prompt" output_key="goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/goal_decomposer/propose.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    load_goal_decompose_review_task_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load goal review task prompt" output_key="goal_decompose_review_task_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/goal_decomposer/review.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    load_goal_decomposer_system_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load goal decomposer system prompt" output_key="goal_decomposer_system_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/goal_decomposer/system.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    load_intent_stack [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_intent_stack" label="Load intent stack" output_key="intent_stack" action_factory_root="${factory_root}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    normalize_approved [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.normalize_approved" label="Normalize approval flag" output_key="approved" action_value="${approved}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    normalize_features [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.normalize_approved_features" label="Normalize approved features" output_key="approved_features" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="goal_intake_decompose" action_approved="${approved}" action_approved_features="${approved_features}" action_goal_issue_json="${goal_issue}" action_decompose_parse_status="${decompose_parse_status}" action_goal_number="${issue_number}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    parse_external_bug_report [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.parse_external_bug_report" label="Parse external bug intake" output_format="json" outputs="external_bug_report,external_bug_errors,external_bug_present,external_bug_intake_activated" action_goal_issue_json="${goal_issue}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    propose [class="goal_decomposer" benchmark_job_id="goal.decompose.propose" llm_path_id="capability.goal_intake_decompose.propose" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="goal.decompose" label="Propose feature breakdown" output_key="proposed_features" output_format="json" reasoning_effort="medium" timeout="${goal_decomposition_timeouts.issue_draft}" prompt="${goal_decomposer_system_prompt}\n\nRepository: ${gh_repo}\n\nIntent stack JSON:\n${intent_stack}\n\nGoal context JSON:\n${goal_context}\n\nReviewer notes (if any):\n${review_notes}\n\n${goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt}" prompt_input_keys="gh_repo,intent_stack,goal_context,review_notes" prompt_source="goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt" session_id="goal-decomposer-${issue_number}" system_prompt_source="goal_decomposer_system_prompt" task_prompt_source="goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt"]
    resolve_decompose_auto_approve [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_boolean" label="Resolve decompose auto-approve toggle" output_key="decompose_auto_approve" action_fallback="false" action_value="${decompose_auto_approve}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    retry_budget [shape="diamond" label="Retry budget left?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    review [class="goal_decomposer" benchmark_job_id="goal.decompose.review" llm_path_id="capability.goal_intake_decompose.review" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="goal.decompose" label="Review decomposition" output_key="review_result" output_format="json" outputs="approved,approved_features,factory_request_goal_graph,review_notes" reasoning_effort="medium" timeout="${goal_decomposition_timeouts.issue_judge}" prompt="${goal_decomposer_system_prompt}\n\nRepository: ${gh_repo}\n\nIntent stack JSON:\n${intent_stack}\n\nGoal context JSON:\n${goal_context}\n\nProposed features JSON:\n${proposed_features}\n\nComplexity floor signal:\n- decompose_complexity=${decompose_complexity}\n- complexity_reason=${reason}\n\n${goal_decompose_review_task_prompt}" prompt_input_keys="gh_repo,intent_stack,goal_context,proposed_features,decompose_complexity,reason" prompt_source="goal_decompose_review_task_prompt" session_id="goal-decomposer-${issue_number}" system_prompt_source="goal_decomposer_system_prompt" task_prompt_source="goal_decompose_review_task_prompt"]
    scan_inventory [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Scan code inventory" output_key="feature_inventory" prompt="# hatch:no-inline-script-ok\nfind apps/hatch/src ${factory_root} -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | head -160" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond"]
    validate_approved_features [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.validate_approved_features" label="Validate approved features non-empty" output_key="approved" action_approved="${approved}" action_approved_features="${approved_features}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    validate_goal_eligible [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.validate_intake" label="Validate goal is open and goal-labeled" output_key="goal_intake_eligible" action_goal_issue_json="${goal_issue}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    load_goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt -> propose -> inspect_proposed_features -> assess_decompose_auto_approve -> decompose_auto_gate
    normalize_features -> done
    start -> fetch_issue -> validate_goal_eligible -> goal_intake_gate
    analyze -> init_attempts
    decide -> inspect_approved [condition="approved=true"]
    decide -> retry_budget [condition="approved!=true"]
    decompose_auto_gate -> inspect_approved [condition="auto_approve=true"]
    decompose_auto_gate -> load_goal_decompose_review_task_prompt [condition="auto_approve!=true"]
    emit_retry_fallback_defect -> fallback [input_key="goal_issue"]
    fallback -> normalize_features [input_key="goal_issue"]
    fetch_skill -> load_intent_stack
    goal_intake_gate -> done [condition="goal_intake_eligible!=eligible" label="ineligible: skip"]
    goal_intake_gate -> parse_external_bug_report [condition="goal_intake_eligible=eligible"]
    inc_attempts -> decide
    init_attempts -> init_parse_diagnostics
    init_parse_diagnostics -> resolve_decompose_auto_approve
    inject_retry_signal -> load_goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt
    inspect_approved -> normalize_features [input_key="goal_issue"]
    inspect_fallback -> emit_retry_fallback_defect [input_key="goal_issue"]
    list_issues -> scan_inventory
    load_goal_decompose_analyze_task_prompt -> analyze
    load_goal_decompose_review_task_prompt -> review
    load_goal_decomposer_system_prompt -> load_goal_decompose_analyze_task_prompt
    load_intent_stack -> load_goal_decomposer_system_prompt
    normalize_approved -> validate_approved_features
    parse_external_bug_report -> list_issues
    resolve_decompose_auto_approve -> load_goal_decompose_propose_task_prompt
    retry_budget -> inject_retry_signal [condition="decompose_attempts<2" label="revise"]
    retry_budget -> inspect_fallback [condition="decompose_attempts>=2"]
    review -> normalize_approved
    scan_inventory -> fetch_skill
    validate_approved_features -> inc_attempts
}
